title: Quinnen Williams: I expect to be dominant every week, I wasn't against Giants

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Quinnen Williams: I expect to be dominant every week, I wasn't against Giants
sources.description: After the Cowboys lost to the Giants last Sunday night, defensive tackle Quinnen Williams said the team needs to be critical of themselves in order to clean up what went wrong in the game.
